name: calculate-provisional-tax-south-africa
description: Calculate South African provisional tax (IRP6) payments, check provisional-taxpayer status, compute the basic amount, and quantify 20% underestimation penalty exposure.
requires_human_steps: Submit IRP6 returns on eFiling and pay by the period deadlines (10% penalty on late payment)
Confirm second-period estimates against the 90%/80% accuracy rules with a registered tax practitioner
Penalty remission requests for seriously-calculated estimates are practitioner territory
rule_basis: SARS Guide for Provisional Tax GEN-PT-01-G01 (effective 29 Jun 2026): period formulas, 90%/80%/R1m accuracy rules, 20% underestimation penalty, basic amount + 8% escalation, 10% late-payment penalty; SARS provisional tax page (29 Jun 2026): status exclusions; 2027 individual table, 27% corporate, 45% trust
